_comment: Copy to backend/mcp_servers.json and set MCP_ENABLED=true (or mcp_enabled
in .env) to load these at startup. Every tool a server lists is registered
as mcp__<server>__<tool>, bound to the Integrations Bench station, and
called through the same tool_registry as the built-in tools.
grant_to says who may call them, in either of two shapes.
A list  -- every tool the server offers, to those agents.
A map   -- named tools per agent. Values are the server's own tool names,
or "*" for all of them. Use this whenever a server offers
something you would not hand out with the rest of it: the
filesystem server below is granted read and write, not delete.
Omit grant_to and every specialist gets everything; the boss never does,
because it plans rather than executes. An unknown agent or tool name in a
grant is a logged warning that costs that line, not the server.
